svg.title: Ancient Tailed Demon — Rites of the Sealed. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ancient Tailed Demon classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Demon's Grasp forks into Rending Grip then Howl of Annihilation, or Festering Brand then Consuming Malice. Demon's Marrow forks into Scarred Hide then Unyielding Husk, or Boiling Ichor then Primordial Rampage. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ancient Tailed Demon-classified jutsu (requires classification extension).

Rampage"]}],"design_notes":["Structure (2/4/4, the pre-batch shape): Demon's Grasp raises both Demonic Embrace debuffs and forks into exposure into burst (Rending Grip \u2192 Howl of Annihilation) or a burn (Festering Brand \u2192 Consuming Malice); Demon's Marrow raises both Demonic Vitae buffs and forks into fortress (Scarred Hide \u2192 Unyielding Husk) or sustained amplification (Boiling Ichor \u2192 Primordial Rampage). Each Hidden Art leans on a different tag, and no node is in every legal 4-BP build.","Roster pass: the first pass cut Draft 4's Roar route (Rending Bellow +2 Damage \u2192 Howl of Annihilation +3 Damage, +2% exposure) and hung Roar's +2 on Primordial Rampage. That route was a Roar burst, not a marked-prey twin, and a +2 payoff on a 45 row does not reach the Nuke tier (Arashima's Sundered Sky carries +2 on 45 rows). It is restored with the director pattern: a percentage setup at the Hidden Art (Rending Grip, exposure) and the only flat Damage on the Advanced Art (+2, 45 \u2192 47). Primordial Rampage is back to Increase Damage Given alone.","Damage: Draft 4 lifted Ancient Demon Roar 45 \u2192 50 (semi-nuke to nuke). Now the only flat Damage is Howl of Annihilation's +2 (45 \u2192 47, High tier kept), the roster default for a High row; no Hidden Art carries flat Damage.","Embrace split: exposure belongs to Howl's route (+7%, 35 \u2192 42%) and Afterburn to Malice's (+10%, 35 \u2192 45%), and neither capstone carries the other's tag. A capstone plus the sibling Hidden Art reaches at most exposure 39% / Afterburn 45% (\u2248 \u00d71.39 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.02 on the mark) or exposure 42% / Afterburn 40% (\u2248 \u00d71.42 \u00d7 1.40 \u2248 \u00d71.99), both below the first pass's Malice package (40% / 45%, \u2248 \u00d72.03); with Malice held, exposure stays at +4% (\u00d71.030), inside the roster's \u2264 +5% beside an Afterburn capstone (concerns). Afterburn reads each hit after the damage modifiers, so the two compound; it is not damage over time and caps at 60% of a hit.","Narrow coverage: Roar's +2 is one row on one 60 AP cast per 7 rounds (+4.4% on that cast), so Howl carries an identity-compatible secondary (exposure on the target the Roar is aimed at) rather than more Damage. Exposure +7% on one row is \u2248 \u00d71.05 on the mark, below the anchors' compounded exposure (Shakunetsu +5% on two rows \u2248 \u00d71.075, Blood-Enchanted Eyes +5% on three \u2248 \u00d71.115).","Pricing by reach: Vitae's Increase Damage Given multiplies every hit the caster lands on every target for 3 rounds, so Primordial Rampage stays at +8% (43%, \u00d71.059), not +10%. Its steps are 2/2/4, so the capstone's +4% outweighs Boiling Ichor's +2%.","Fourth-BP comparisons (arithmetic only): Howl + Marrow against Rampage + Grasp puts Roar level on the rest of the circle (47 \u00d7 1.37 \u2248 64.4 against 45 \u00d7 1.43 \u2248 64.4); Howl leads on allies' hits on the mark (\u2248 \u00d71.95 against \u00d71.88) and on Roar on the mark (\u2248 125 against 121), Rampage on the caster's hits against everyone else (+4.4%), slightly on its non-Roar hits on the mark (+0.7%) and in Vitae's third round. Malice + Marrow against Howl + Marrow: Malice +2.1% on every hit the mark takes; Howl's Roar +4.4% on every other enemy in its circle and \u2248 +2.3% on the marked one.","No cross-riders: each Vitae capstone carries only its own route's tag. Capstone plus sibling Hidden Art: 06,07,08,09 gives Increase Damage Given 39% / Decrease Damage Taken 35%; 06,07,09,10 gives 43% / 30%.","Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Increase Damage Given +8%, Increase Damage Taken +7%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Afterburn +10%. Top package (R14\u2032, flat Damage included): Howl of Annihilation with Demon's Marrow, \u00d71.015 \u00d7 1.052 \u00d7 47/45 \u2248 \u00d71.115 on Roar's hit on the mark (percentage only, Primordial Rampage with Demon's Grasp leads at \u00d71.059 \u00d7 1.015 \u2248 \u00d71.075), under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.234.","Delivery: all three jutsu have cooldown 7 and no buff or debuff row acts in its own cast round (\u00a73b). Embrace (one target, 40 AP) and Vitae (self, 40 AP) go a round before Roar (60 AP AoE circle) to touch it; Vitae's Increase Damage Given (3 rounds) raises Roar on every enemy in the circle, Embrace's debuffs only on the marked one."],"risks":["Classification: no kit row carries an element, so 'Ancient Tailed Demon' is the placeholder name of a new jutsu classification (requires classification extension), not a bloodline-id selector; all three kit jutsu qualify only through it (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Targeting None instead would reach every non-elemental row. Off-kit coverage is unverified.","Embrace leverage: its exposure (up to 42%) and Afterburn (up to 45%) apply to every non-pierce hit the marked target takes from the caster and allies for 2 rounds, so team play is worth more than the solo numbers. Afterburn sources add and cap at 60% of each hit, so a second Afterburn source saturates it.","Route balance between Howl of Annihilation, Consuming Malice and Primordial Rampage is arithmetic only (per-hit multipliers, Roar damage assumed proportional to EP); no combat simulation.","Pierce: the four percentage tags do not touch pierce hits (pierce resolves after the damage modifiers and Afterburn skips it), and the kit has no pierce row, so pierce damage stays outside the tree.","Ally hazard: Ancient Demon Roar's unsupported Wound row (35%, friendly fire none) lands on allies inside the circle; the caster is never a target (\u00a74b). Howl's route invites more Roar casts. Embrace aimed at an ally (OTHER_USER permits it) would land both raised debuffs on that ally.","Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance); not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"01":"How do I make the demon's mark pay: open the prey for the Roar, or burn it down?","06":"How do I strengthen the host: hit everything harder or refuse to fall?"},"route_identities":{"03":"burst: exposure set up on the mark, controlled +2 Damage payoff on Roar's whole circle","05":"burn on the marked prey: one target takes 45% Afterburn on every instant non-pierce hit, allies' included","08":"fortress","10":"sustained amplification: every own hit on any target harder for 3 rounds"},"director_review":"Roster questions: DQ-B (Howl of Annihilation +7% Increase Damage Taken on 1 row: Demonic Embrace 35 \u2192 42%; \u2248 \u00d71.052, against Shakunetsu Sakura \u00d71.075 and Blood-Enchanted Eyes \u00d71.115); held below the single-row +10% because Howl also pays Roar's +2 and its exposure stacks with Festering Brand's Afterburn on the same mark: at 2/2/6 (Embrace 45%) Howl + Festering Brand would reach \u2248 \u00d71.45 \u00d7 1.40 \u2248 \u00d72.03 on the mark, above Consuming Malice's best (\u2248 \u00d72.02 with Rending Grip).","concerns":["Rending Grip (+2% exposure) and Festering Brand (+3% Afterburn) both raise what Embrace's target takes, so at the Hidden tier they read alike; they differ in mechanics (exposure also multiplies residual ticks and the hit Afterburn reads; Afterburn skips pierce and shares a 60% per-hit cap) and in the payoff each leads to.","Howl of Annihilation is the narrowest route in 1v1: its +2 lands on one 60 AP cast per 7 rounds and it trails Consuming Malice by \u2248 2.1% on every hit the mark takes. It leads Malice when several enemies stand in Roar's circle (+4.4% on each other enemy) and leads Primordial Rampage on allies' hits on the mark (\u2248 \u00d71.95 against \u00d71.88). Not simulated.","Cross-route stack: Rending Grip is a legal fourth for Consuming Malice and Festering Brand for Howl, so one 40 AP Embrace cast reaches exposure 39% / Afterburn 45% (\u2248 \u00d72.02 on the mark, party-wide) or 42% / 40% (\u2248 \u00d71.99); with Malice held exposure stays at +4% (\u00d71.030), inside the roster's \u2264 +5% beside an Afterburn capstone. R16 accepts the stack (no allocation exceeds \u2248 \u00d71.115 with flat Damage, under \u00d71.234), and the other setups for Rending Grip are worse: Afterburn would be a stacking twin of Festering Brand (Malice's fourth, past +10%); a self Increase Damage Given setup is not a legal fourth for Primordial Rampage (it needs Demon's Grasp), so it is not a twin of Boiling Ichor but would put a host buff under the mark's Foundation and pull Howl toward Primordial Rampage's Vitae amplification; Decrease Damage Taken does nothing for the route's hits. Neither stack is dominant: on the caster's hits Malice + Demon's Marrow ties Malice + Rending Grip (\u2248 \u00d71.37 \u00d7 1.37 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.72 against \u00d71.35 \u00d7 1.39 \u00d7 1.45 \u2248 \u00d72.72), so Grip leads only on allies' hits (\u2248 \u00d72.02 against \u00d71.99) and gives up Vitae's +2% / +2%; Howl + Festering Brand (+3% Afterburn) instead leads on every hit the mark takes (the caster's \u2248 \u00d72.68 against \u00d72.67, allies' \u2248 \u00d71.99 against \u00d71.95), while Howl + Demon's Marrow keeps Roar +1.5% on the rest of the circle, Vitae's third round and Decrease Damage Taken 27%.","Classification extension ('Ancient Tailed Demon' jutsu classification) remains a director/engine decision."]}}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
ANCIENT TAILED DEMON CLASSIFICATION · REQUIRES CLASSIFICATION EXTENSION
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ancient Tailed Demon-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Howl of Annihilation path + Demon's Marrow
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE ANCIENT TAILED DEMON KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ancient Tailed Demon classification / forked tree
